title: Ebar Jombey Moja
overview: Ebar Jombe Moja is a 2017 Bengali comedy film starring Ishan Majumder, Aviraj, Prithwiraj Banerjee, Sanghamitra Roy and Ujjaini Banerjee. Three friends- Kaushik, Nirmal and Abhijeet are bored with their mundane life and decide to have some fun without informing their wives. The men lie to their spouses and check in to a resort in Kolkata. However, their wives come to know about the plan and arrive at the hotel to catch them red handed.
